statements.text: In AST, attention is selective attention: a process in which one set of cortical signals is enhanced and competing signals are suppressed, so that the enhanced signals have a much larger effect on decision, memory and behavior. It covers bottom up capture and top down control, and applies to any representable item, external or internal.

sources.locator: A Theory of Consciousness that Embodies Principles 1 and 2
sources.quote: Attention here refers specifically to selective attention, a process by which one set of cortical signals is enhanced and competing signals are suppressed
To attend to a stimulus is to have its representation win a competition, thus gaining greater signal strength
